site: Cross-portal form interaction (iCIMS, Workday, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters)
class: Instantaneous synthetic input fills trigger anti-bot telemetry and challenge blocks
symptom: Form fields filled instantaneously (0ms) trigger telemetry detection from anti-bot mechanisms (hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, DataDome), and custom input controls with keydown listeners do not fire or register values properly.
root_cause: Locator.fill() in Playwright sets the value property and dispatches input/change events instantly without keyboard event sequences or inter-field natural pauses.
why_tests_missed: Mock-based DOM tests do not measure typing speed or keydown/keyup event stream intervals; initial typing tests did not test dropped password characters or decimal separators in numeric fields.
fix: Implement human-cadence typing (press_sequentially with 30-65ms variable delay) for short form inputs (<200 chars), with direct fill fallback for long essays and keydown-prevented fields, controlled by HUMAN_TYPING environment variable (default 1 in runtime, 0 in test suite). Verification requires exact readback by default (including case, decimals, and symbols) so dropped password or numeric characters trigger immediate fallback fill; only recognized masked phone number inputs allow formatting differences.
prevention: Default to realistic keystroke cadences and inter-field pauses on all user-facing ATS input fields while keeping the test suite fast via HUMAN_TYPING=0 in conftest.
